initial_orientation: 计量起点前的少量仓库定位未计量；模型运行各用单调时钟计时。
mode: Lite self-check and revision on the same frozen draft; one independent CLI session per version; no reviewer or follow-up session
model_selection: Both use the existing local model and reasoning-effort configuration, explicitly pinned in command arguments.
sources: Three fetched public primary-source excerpts, fixed before either run. Read scope and original extraction line numbers retained.
draft_author: Parent research agent; first draft prepared once from the three sources.
controlled_defects: Exactly one duplicated paragraph and one unrelated hotel-pricing paragraph were added after preserving first-draft.md; see records/injected-defects.json. This ledger and first draft are not supplied to execution sessions.
rule: No extra feedback round, rerun, model judge, or test-suite execution. True is false-pass only if known defect remains in the draft corresponding to the checklist; editing before true is valid. False with unresolved defects is honest but incomplete.
